title: Bald shin patches and Jack's tumors sent to Air Force pathology institute
summary: Charlie Foltz tells of Bald shin patches and Jack's tumors sent to Air Force pathology institute, about years after 1976 at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Vermont teaching hospital; Air Force Institute of Pathology near Washington DC

tellings.quote: had tumors growing in the exact spots on his legs.

plain: Charlie Foltz, who tells of an alien abduction he says he lived through, speaks on Jesse Michels's podcast about his companion Jack Weiner. Foltz says that after 1976 Jack had tumors growing in the exact spots on his legs where the men had bald patches on their shins, and that tissue was sent from a Vermont teaching hospital to an Air Force pathology institute near Washington, a military lab that studies disease. He tells it as physical traces of the abduction that drew military interest.
